findings.title: Create a new default version of an attached policy
findings.message: arn:aws:iam::314973283544:user/path-9f97834b/user-2a6a6391 can act as effective admin of account 314973283544 using iam:CreatePolicyVersion
findings.remediation: Remove iam:CreatePolicyVersion or scope it to policies that are not attached to the caller; deny it in a permissions boundary.

findings.title: Attach a managed policy to its own user
findings.message: arn:aws:iam::314973283544:user/path-8f417928/user-22560ed1 can act as effective admin of account 314973283544 using iam:AttachUserPolicy
findings.remediation: Remove the action from the principal's policies, scope its Resource to other entities, or add a permissions boundary that denies it. A condition on iam:PolicyARN can limit which policies may be attached.
